Evaluate this project: An app that helps freelancers track unpaid invoices and auto-send payment reminders via email and SMS.

{"pain_severity":{"score":8,"reason":"Unpaid invoices cause financial stress for freelancers"},"pain_frequency":{"score":7,"reason":"Requires attention multiple times per month"},"existing_alternatives":{"score":5,"reason":"No existing solutions specifically cater to freelance invoicing needs"},"willingness_to_pay":{"score":9,"reason":"Freelancers willing to invest time in finding better solutions"},"market_size":{"score":9,"reason":"Large number of freelancers worldwide"},"scalability":{"score":9,"reason":"App can scale easily with user growth"},"profitability_potential":{"score":8,"reason":"Commission-based or subscription-based models possible"},"defensibility":{"score":6,"reason":"Competitors may have similar features but different branding and marketing strategies"},"time_to_value":{"score":8,"reason":"Easy to onboard new users and integrate with existing accounting tools"},"founder_market_fit_requirement":{"score":4,"reason":"Basic fintech knowledge needed but not deep domain expertise"},"overall_score":7.3,"summary":"Strong idea with clear pain point and large market.
